Officer observed smoke and open flame in the brush strip outside the rear perimeter fence. Fire spread along the fence line and burned through the rear vehicle gate before the fire department extinguished it at 00:31. No injuries. Rear gate is not functional and is currently chained shut.

Officer called 911 at 23:49, notified the account manager and property management at 23:55, kept people clear of the area and met the fire department at the front entrance. Officer remained posted at the rear gate until 02:00.
Fire Department (911), Property Management
Fire department believes the fire started at an encampment in the brush strip. Individual seen leaving the area.
Patrol officer was on meal break 23:30-00:00; second check of rear gate was 23:12.
Routine patrols completed. No issues.
